key_insights: Presents a general 3-step method (read, write, speak) for improving verbal articulation, unrelated to college admissions.

Recommends journaling one page daily, reflecting on past events or planning future conversations, to organize thoughts before speaking.
Recommends practicing 5-minute impromptu speaking sessions with a trusted person on a topic drawn from that day's journaling.
Claims most people see communication improvement within about two weeks of consistent practice.
